value.rationale: This is a complete exact evaluation of a standard four-point Banach-space invariant on real ell_4 in every dimension at least three. It reveals a strict dimension jump from the known planar value and identifies a genuinely tetrahedral extremizer, while the upper bound proves that no further gain is possible in higher dimension.
risks: The exponent-four result does not solve the general ell_p family.
